newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone moving into Fiji islands with 130 mph wind.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone moving into Fiji islands with 130 mph wind.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Gavin is moving into the Fiji islands with top winds near the centre of the storm estimated at 130 mph, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Dangerous seas will hit shipping in the region, WSC warned.
The hardest hit area will most likely be Vanua Levu. The northern coastline can expect a damaging storm surge,along with strong and damaging winds.
Gavin is likely to bring heavy rains, flooding and wind damage to most of the region.
